name: Caverns of Time generates an Echo Fragment from Discordance (#1943)
contract: Caverns of Time 520166 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Echo Fragment 804455, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Discordance (100% chance), a single Discordance hit should generate one Echo Fragment.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Echo Fragment before any cast
Discordance's hit generates an Echo Fragment
